usedFor: Google Drive holds your files, and Zoho Mail gets a “Create Draft” email for each new or changed file.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Updated File in specific folder” in Google Drive, then “Create Draft” in Zoho Mail
bestTemplate.why: A file added to the watched folder gets a draft ready in Zoho Mail, so you only write the message.

watchOut: “New or Updated File in specific folder” is polling and also fires on edits, so one file can draft twice.
